thirdparty-darkreader.privacySummary: Dark Reader requests access to sites you allow so it can transform their visible appearance. This reviewed package has no catalog download, remote configuration refresh, news fetch, or extension-update channel.
thirdparty-darkreader.retentionPolicy: Settings remain only on this device in the selected profile while installed; storage.sync is device-local rather than cloud-synchronized. Removing the extension deletes its package data; Private Browsing uses isolated ephemeral data.
